input: Map out all upcoming family birthdays this year

gold.taskTitle: Map Out All Family Birthdays This Year
gold.taskDescription: Collect and organize all upcoming family birthday dates for the remainder of this year into a clear, accessible reference.

questions.title: Which family members are you including in this list?
questions.description: Define the scope: immediate family only, extended family, in-laws, or all of the above.

questions.title: Where do you currently store family birthday information?
questions.description: Identify existing sources such as contacts app, social media, memory, or a physical calendar.

questions.title: What format do you want the final output in?
questions.description: Determine the preferred format: a digital calendar, spreadsheet, written list, phone reminders, or something else.

questions.title: How far in advance do you want birthday reminders?
questions.description: Clarify the lead time for alerts: one day before, one week before, two weeks before, etc.

questions.title: Do you want to include ages or just the dates?
questions.description: Decide whether to track birth years and calculate ages alongside the birthday dates.

questions.title: Will you need to reach out to family members to confirm missing dates?
questions.description: Assess whether all birthdays are already known or if some require asking relatives directly.

questions.title: Are there specific birthdays you want to plan celebrations for?
questions.description: Identify if this list is purely for awareness or if certain birthdays require extra planning steps.
